articles.title: iPhone to Windows clipboard sharing coming to iOS 28 in the EU
articles.description: If you've ever wanted to copy something on your iPhone and paste it on your Windows PC, the feature is coming in a fall 2027 release of iOS 28 to users in the EU. Sharing files from iPhone to Windows is coming to the EU Third-party developers can request interoperability features to be developed by Apple via a web portal . If the request is deemed possible it can take anywhere from six months to eighteen months to build the feature and submit it for release. One such request was made by Microsoft (Request ID: FB22329535) for cross-device clipboard sharing access between iOS and Windows. The request was submitted on March 25, 2026, and after being reviewed by Apple, was approved on June 26, 2026. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

articles.title: Russia Accelerates Deployment Of Rassvet Low-Earth-Orbit Satellite Network, Challenges Starlink
articles.description: Russia is accelerating deployment of Rassvet, a home-grown low-Earth-orbit satellite network designed to reduce Moscow’s dependence on Elon Musk’s Starlink. Bureau 1440 has launched two operational batches, bringing the number of Rassvet spacecraft sent into orbit—including earlier prototypes—to approximately 38. The company says its satellites could deliver gigabit internet, low latency and laser connections between spacecraft. The constellation remains far too small for continuous coverage and currently offers only limited communication windows. However, even intermittent links could support scheduled intelligence transfers, isolated units and long-range drone operations. Russia ultimately envisions a network of approximately 300 satellites for nationwide coverage, potentially expanding to 900, although production delays make that timetable uncertain. Rassvet is not yet a Russian Starlink—but Moscow is building an orbital system that no American company or foreign government could switch off. Watch.
